nodes.name: Electrodeposition of Hydroxides
nodes.procedure: Ni(OH)2 / Y(OH)3 was in-situ loaded on the graphite plate by nitrate ion intercalation enhanced electrodeposition method. During electrodeposition process, the NO3- was reduced to yield OH- , which subsequently results in the co-deposition of Ni(OH)2 and Y(OH)3 on the GP substrate. Due to the small solubility product constant (Ksp) , Ni(OH)2 and Y(OH)3 will rapidly and uniformly be electro-deposited on the GP substrate.

nodes.name: Selective High-Temperature Reduction
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Ni(OH)2 / Y(OH)3 precursor electrode was transformed into the Ni / Y2O3 electrode by a high-temperature selective reduction method. During this process, Y(OH)3 first decomposed into Y2O3 below 500 C. Ni(OH)2 / Y(OH)3 was selectively reduced to Ni / Y2O3 under a H2 / Ar atmosphere at 500 C.
